info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector ImageApi API
ImageApi
Microsoft Azure Get Images For A Given Project Iteration Or Workspace

params.name: projectId
params.description: The project id.

params.name: iterationId
params.description: The iteration id. Defaults to workspace.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: A list of tags ids to filter the images. Defaults to all tagged images when null. Limited to 20.

params.name: taggingStatus
params.description: The tagging status filter. It can be 'All', 'Tagged', or 'Untagged'. Defaults to 'All'.

params.name: $filter
params.description:
An expression to filter the images against image metadata. Only images where the expression evaluates to true are included in the response.
The expression supports eq (Equal), ne (Not equal), and (Logical and), or (Logical or) operators.
Here is an example, metadata=key1 eq 'value1' and key2 ne 'value2'.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The ordering. Defaults to newest.

params.name: take
params.description: Maximum number of images to return. Defaults to 50, limited to 256.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of images to skip before beginning the image batch. Defaults to 0.

items.docs:
This API supports batching and range selection. By default it will only return first 50 images matching images.
Use the {take} and {skip} parameters to control how many images to return in a given batch.
The filtering is on an and/or relationship. For example, if the provided tag ids are for the "Dog" and
"Cat" tags, then only images tagged with Dog and/or Cat will be returned

info.name: Microsoft Azure Add The Provided Images To The Set Of Training Images

params.name: projectId
params.description: The project id.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: The tags ids with which to tag each image. Limited to 20.

items.docs:
This API accepts body content as multipart/form-data and application/octet-stream. When using multipart
multiple image files can be sent at once, with a maximum of 64 files.
If all images are successful created, 200(OK) status code will be returned.
Otherwise, 207 (Multi-Status) status code will be returned and detail status for each image will be listed in the response payload.

params.description: Flag to specify delete all images, specify this flag or a list of images. Using this flag will return a 202 response to indicate the images are being deleted.

params.name: allIterations
params.description: Removes these images from all iterations, not just the current workspace. Using this flag will return a 202 response to indicate the images are being deleted.
